questions.prompt: Which is the definition of protection?
options: Defense of the system against internal and external attacks
Any mechanism for controlling the access of processes or users to resources defined by the OS

questions.prompt: Defense of the system against internal and external attacks is called ______. (one word)
Which of these is NOT listed as a security threat?
A system with perfect protection mechanisms is automatically secure.
What does a user ID include?
options: A name and an associated number, one per user

questions.prompt: Which identifier lets a set of users be defined and managed together? (two words)
Changing to an effective ID with more rights is called privilege ______. (one word)
The user ID is associated with all of that user's files and processes, to determine access control.
